# Saksoft Limited (SAKSOFT) — Research Brief

## Q4 FY26 Financial Highlights (as of 11 June 2026)

### Revenue & Profit
- **Revenue from operations:** ₹256.23 crore (Q4 FY26) [6][7]
- **Net profit:** ~₹35.93–36 crore (Q4 FY26) [6][7]
- **Year-on-year growth:** Revenue +4%, Net profit +20% [6][7]
- **PAT margin:** 14.44% [10]
- **EBITDA margin:** 18.19% (earnings call, 26-May-2026) [6][7]
- **Sequential (QoQ) changes:** Not quantified in any extracted source.

## Dividend & Capital Returns
- **Interim dividend (declared Nov 2025):** ₹0.45 per share [4]
- **Final dividend (proposed 25-May-2026, subject to approval):** ₹0.55 per share [1][2]
- **Total for FY26 (if approved):** ₹1.00 per share (₹0.45 + ₹0.55) [1][2][4]

## Management Changes
- Cessation of V.V.R. Babu as per exchange filings [8][9]

## Valuation & Market Data (as of 10 June 2026)
- **Share price (NSE):** ₹142.28 [19]
- **Market cap:** ₹1,767 crore [20]
- **P/E ratio (trailing):** 13.56 [20]; **Forward P/E:** 4.05 [20]
- **Price-to-book:** 2.27 [20]
- **EV/EBITDA:** 8.62 [20]
- **Dividend yield:** ~0.70% [20]
- **EPS (trailing):** ₹10.19 [20]
- **52-week range:** ₹107.59 – ₹253.99 [20]

## Open Questions & Data Gaps
- **Revenue breakdown** (geography/service line) – not available in Q4 filings or transcript [6][7]
- **Order pipeline, deal wins, client additions, client concentration** – not discussed in earnings call [6][7][10]
- **Management forward guidance** (near-term demand, hiring, margins) – no extractable commentary [6][7][10]
- **Sequential quarterly comparisons** – no quantified data in available sources [12][13][15][17]

## Key Sources Used
- Exchange filings: Q4 FY26 results [1][2], interim dividend [4], transcripts [6][7], management change [8][9]
- Earnings call transcript [6][7], newspaper publication [10]
- Stock price and fundamentals via NSE/Yahoo finance [19][20]

*Note: Segmental revenue data may be available in the FY2024‑25 annual report [11] or investor presentation [5] but were not extracted in this run.*
